newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Dain starts RDO with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Dain starts RDO with buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Tuesday it has begun coverage of RDO Equipment Inc with a buy rating.

-- "As the largest retailer of industrial and agricutultural equipment manufactured by Deere & Co, RDO is in an ideal position to be a force in the consolidation of the Deere dealer body," analyst J. Blair Brumley wrote in a research report.

-- Earnings estimate for the fiscal 1997 fourth quarter ended in January is $0.04 a share, up from $0.03 a share a year ago, and full fiscal 1998 estimate is $0.95 a share, up from an estimate $0.67, Brumley said.
